about: Labelled example questions Ben's intent k-NN votes with. Shipped as vectors only. Must never share a question with cases.json (enforced by a test). course = system design or software architecture, including trade-off opinions about technology. tech = general software or computing outside the lessons. debate = non-technical opinion, values, religion, politics. off_topic = everyday non-technical requests. self = about Ben, greetings, small talk.
